title: Abbas Kaha Ho Meri Imdad Ko Aao
body:
Abbas kaha ho meri imdaad ko aao
Maajaye ka sar kat tay hi is dasht-e-bala main, aaye hain sitamgar yahaan khaimo ko jalane, baba bhi nahi aaye hain Zainab ko bacchane, is ban main loot ti hoon madad karne aoo
Wo raat ka sannata wo bacchon ka bilakh na, aur khouf se za lim ke wo bewoa ka larazna, dekha nahin jata hai Sakina ka tadapna, kurte main lagi aag hai tum aake bacchao
Masoom ko durre jo lagata hain sitamgar, khamoosh khade rote hain bas Abid-e-bimar, kaano se lahoo behta hain aur soojhe hain ruqsar, ab aake bhatijee ko kaleje se lagayo
<<DIVIDER>>
Zehra ki bahoo betiyon ke haath badhein hai, be maqna-o-chadar sar-e-bazaar phire hai, darbar main zalim ke bhi sar nange khade hai, hota ha i taroof mera tum aake rukaoo
Jab beeswi ramzan ko ye baba ne kaha tha, Zainab tere baazo main rasan bandhein ge aada, par dil ko yakeen tha mere abbbas hain zinda, ab cheenti hai chadar meri tum aake dilaoo
Zanjeer main jakhda hain mera Abid-e-dilgir, chalne main usse hoti hain ek lamha jo taqeer, naize se aziyat usse pouncha te hain be peer, bimar ko tum aake laieen no choodaoo
Nouha ye likha moosavi ne ba dil-e-purnam, hasrat hai karoon rouza pa phir majlis-o-matam, aur saath hain parwane sada dete hain paiham, bhaiyya ye azadaro ko rouze pa bulaoo..
